classification.difficultyReason: Infer the full rectangular height, subtract the rectangular notch and add a triangle with given perpendicular height.

content.prompt: Find the area of the region shown below.

spec.description: Complete actual source givens, perpendicular heights/equality families and mathematical shaded regions retained. Native editable black10pt figure, no derived dimensions.

answer.worked:
The full rectangle is 6 cm by $3+1=4$ cm. Subtract the notch and add the triangle on the right, whose vertical base is 4 cm and perpendicular height is 4 cm.

$$\begin{aligned}A&=6(4)-2(1)+\tfrac12(4)(4)\\A&=24-2+8=30\text{ cm}^2.\end{aligned}$$
